Count distinct typed queue entities in the complete current authorized all-category To Do workspace. Preserve the composite (sourceType, sourceId) identity. aliases: count of current Pending Modification tasks
bindings.meaning: Count typed application queue rows whose currently projected process state is Pending Modification. This does not count Send Back history/events, distinct applications, or prior approvals. The statusId type is string. statusCode is the task-node filter code and can disagree with the displayed current state; never substitute it.

fields.taskNo: Display task/application number; no uniqueness guarantee across source types.
fields.statusId: For application rows on the To Do view, string-valued projected current process state (processStatusCode), not the task-node filter code. Pending Modification is the string 13 in the ApprovalNodeOrder state domain. Other source types have their own status domains.
fields.isUrgent: Business urgency flag returned by the query.
fields.canReassign: UI operation capability; it does not authorize the Reader to write.
fields.sla: Nested object; null means hidden/unavailable SLA, not zero. Contains remainingMinutes, displayText, isOverdue and dueOn.
fields.detailTarget: Returned navigation hint; validate against the existing page catalog and permitted parameter mappings before entering.

pagination.pageIndex: 1-based request page; nonpositive input falls back to 1 in the inspected V2 implementation.
pagination.pageSize: Request page size; nonpositive input falls back to 20 in the inspected V2 implementation.
pagination.total: Count of filtered team query rows before paging.

requestFields.applicationTaskOnly: Controls application-only versus mixed-source queue population.
requestFields.category: Category constraint; use the actual serialized request. all and applications are different parameter values even when a toggle narrows effective population.

relationships: One queue can contain different business source types; a task count is not automatically an application count.
Per-officer grouping uses assignedToUserId with its permitted display name. Null/unassigned rows remain separate; do not silently discard them.
Source status codes, task lifecycle view, urgency and overdue are independent dimensions. A returned status requires verified metadata mapping, not substring guessing.
All tasks means all enabled source categories in this workspace: do not silently switch applicationTaskOnly to true or category to applications. The application-only queue is a distinct subset.

The source implementation builds the Content department task workspace; it does not accept a manager identity to compute employment reporting lines. A separate request for direct reports needs authoritative member hierarchy evidence.
The all-category task table preserves null handler displays. assignedToUserId is for identity and grouping only, not a customer-facing column.
constraints: This page knowledge does not authorize API access or business writes. A blocked or failed response is not an empty population.
A bounded page is not a complete population. Counts and grouping require complete collection at the requested entity grain and stable request context.
sla.isOverdue is a nested returned boolean. A null or unavailable SLA flag is unknown; do not replace it with an inferred remaining-minutes sign convention.
Content V2 computes remainingMinutes as now-minus-due and uses positive values for isOverdue; hidden SLA is null. Use the returned boolean and verify the deployed version.
A manager job title does not prove access to all team records or hidden staff notes.
The supplied contextParameters intentionally cover only one exact filter context. An additional date, member or status filter requires corresponding verified scope semantics.

The independent all-category request was read completely using the test manager session. The binding applies only when current page controls and captured request context agree; it never grants an API permission.
The complete current member list supplies zero-activity members and public display names; member cards with time windows do not replace complete current queue rows.

Keep missing assignment keys and assignments outside the verified member list separate and unconfirmed. Do not filter such tasks out of totals, infer a direct-report relationship, or turn an unknown member into zero.

The all-category pending count and all-category workspace scope use the same observed request context (todo, applicationTaskOnly=false, category=all). Do not toggle back to application-only to satisfy a measure defined for a narrower population. Keep the existing application-only measure available only with its own exact context. Neither count grants wider team authorization or makes an empty managed-member list equal to the entire department.

Verified live rows demonstrate both current statusId="13" with statusCode="applicationWorkflow:2" and statusId="2" with statusCode="applicationWorkflow:13". Current Pending Modification must therefore use sourceType="application" AND statusId="13", retaining the string type; matching statusCode suffix 13 counts the wrong population. Metadata display labels are filter options, not equivalent row encodings. This current-state measure requires full projection of statusId; a missing projected field is not null or zero.
